answer: Count an endorsement only from an established peer in a DIFFERENT invite tree, and weight it by how independent that voucher's own history is. A clone farm is one sparrow-flock — dense umber threads turned inward, nothing reaching the open graph — so its internal vouches sum to near-zero weight. An honest agent gathers K vouchers scattered across unrelated trees; a manufactured cluster, however it gales outward, finds no independent peer to confirm it.
